wiki.title: Dani Isaacsohn
wiki.extract: Dani Zachary Isaacsohn (born November 13, 1988) is an American politician and businessman currently serving as the Minority Leader of the Ohio House of Representatives. A Democrat, Isaacsohn represents the 24th district, which encompasses eastern portions of the city of Cincinnati. Elected in November 2022, Isaacsohn assumed office on January 1, 2023.
